content: The system does more changes than are strictly necessary and often replaces correct words and phrases, for example "frequently" was changed to to "often" or in Estonian “öelda” ("say") to “avaldada” ("publish"). Sometimes this also confuses the meaning: "siblings" was changed to "friends".
